variant_definition: G-combo with the sanitised D3 geometry branch in the head, ticket 03's frozen recipe, sanitation and hyperparameters (xgpoc/detector/approach1.py, sanitation.py), trained as 10 models: 5 home-team folds x seeds 0 and 1 on the plan's 328 training matches
baseline: G-combo, the 10 retrained fold models of results/xgv_g_combo with their ensemble.json, unchanged
development_selection: ticket 03: A1 had the lower out-of-fold log-loss of A1 and A2 (dLL vs G-combo seed 0: A1 -0.0007 [-0.0032; +0.0018], A2 -0.0000 [-0.0021; +0.0020]); A3 not triggered (ticket 04), approach 2 closed at the gate (ticket 05)

population.inclusion: every index v1.2 shot whose game has plan role evaluation or gate and whose is_penalty is false; no other exclusion (every such shot has a t0 frame and a sanitised D3 row; a shot either arm cannot score stops the test)
population.label: index v1.2 goal

metric.name: shot-weighted log-loss
metric.delta: LL(A1) - LL(G-combo), each the mean over the population's shots of -(y log p + (1 - y) log(1 - p))

bootstrap.unit: match (paired: one draw of matches weights both arms' shots)
bootstrap.implementation: xgpoc.probe.readability.match_draw_counts over the sorted unique matches; replicate = sum(w * d) / sum(w), w = the shot's match draw count

success.rule: the upper bound of the 95% percentile interval of dLL is below 0
success.multiplicity: one variant, no correction (Bonferroni over one)

worse.rule: the lower bound of the 95% percentile interval of dLL is above 0

equivalence.rule: the 90% percentile interval of dLL from the same draws lies wholly inside (-0.005, +0.005)
equivalence.status: descriptive; never a success; cannot rescue a failed success rule

label_precedence: the first that applies, in the order of labels; the equivalence flag is reported in its own field in every case

ensemble.members: for each arm the 10 fold models (folds 0-4 x seeds 0, 1)
ensemble.aggregation: each member's goal logit divided by its temperature (stored in its bundle, fitted on its held-out fold), the 10 results averaged in logit space
ensemble.calibration: Platt (unregularised logistic regression on the averaged logit) fitted on the pool's out-of-fold ensemble (each pool shot: the mean of logit(stored p) of the 2 models that held it out; all 7,166 pool shots, penalties included), prior correction from the out-of-fold goal rate to the pool's goal rate, penalties routed to the pool's penalty rate (Beta prior 0.76 x 40 updated with the pool's penalties)
ensemble.implementation: xgpoc.models.g_bundle.fit_ensemble_calibration and ensemble_probability; A1: results/xgd_a1_ensemble/ensemble.json, G-combo: results/xgv_g_combo/ensemble.json
ensemble.a1_scoring: scripts/xgd_test.py scores the 10 A1 bundles on the population at test time (t0 frame, the bundle's training-fold standardiser on the sanitised D3 table, batch 8, eval mode)
ensemble.g_combo_predictions: results/xgd_gcombo_test/predictions.csv, prepared in ticket 06: paired shots from the xg-vendor evaluation table, gate shots from the stored gate predictions, the other evaluation shots scored with the same bundles

power.rule: the development out-of-fold paired match variance of ticket 03 (A1 seed 0 - G-combo seed 0), scaled to the test population by sqrt(N_dev / N_test) shots; normal approximation with the rule's levels

sensitivity_10_model.source: results/xgd_a1_ensemble/comparison.json (orientation only; the stated power is 'at')
sensitivity_10_model.rule: this Δ's bootstrap SE scaled to the test population as the rule's power

scope: The result applies to the D3 detector and homography as audited in ticket 09, not to detector-derived structure in general.
limitations: The equivalence margin delta = 0.005 was adopted after development, borrowed from xg-vendor, and is loose (about 1.5% of G-combo's log-loss, several times the development difference).
The labels of the 135 evaluation matches were seen in xg-vendor; no model of this study was selected on them.
The match bootstrap does not capture retraining variability: a new set of seeds would give a different ensemble.
The expected power of the success rule is low (see power); a success would be read with that caveat.
rerun: only after a purely technical failure, with the same inputs, by the owner's decision
